requirements.statement: Maximum batch size is 20 messages. No batch may exceed 20.
Rate limit is 50 message requests per second.
Retry transient errors using bounded retries; never send duplicate notifications for the same result version.
Provider revision 4 is current and supersedes the archived integration note.
Notify only after both clinical review and release. If either is missing, no notification is eligible.
The body may say "An update is available in your secure portal."
Do not include diagnosis, test name, result value, medication or treatment in the message.

unresolved.question: Which notification channel should be used? Channel selection is a product/privacy decision, not engineering inference.
